ns2:course.label: Head/Neck Ca & Neuro Voice Dis
ns2:course.description: Advanced study and critical analysis of the literature pertaining to anatomic, physiologic, acoustic, and psychological bases of voice pathology and laryngectomy. Includes methods of diagnosis and treatment. Prerequisite: SHS 300, SHS 301, SHS 411 or equivalent or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: SHS 300, SHS 301, SHS 411 or equivalent or consent of instructor.
